en.t: Yes, that side might be a little better.

units.source_text: 御宝的樱花只要看上一眼，也就算领略到春天的大自然景色啦。”

en.t: If you just take one look at the cherry blossoms at Mitakara, you can say you have savored the natural scenery of spring.

units.source_text: 太吉郎说着走出山门，乘上了汽车。

en.t: Taikichiro said this as he walked out through the temple gate and got into the car.
